description: Build the 3D model of a house on its building outline (from import_buildings), at true size and in its place: the main block — walls up to the eaves and a plain gable roof, default colours. Then shape it step by step: house_set_roof, house_set_walls, house_set_openings, and house_set_block for further blocks (a wing, a garage, a porch) assembled from the same simple boxes-with-roofs. A porch, carport or pergola is posts plus an open block: posts are thin blocks (about 0.15 × 0.15 m, no roof), the roof an open block (open: true) at the eave height. Tell it which compass side the front (entrance) facade faces — read it from the photos and get_site_analysis. Calling it again starts that house over. Look at the result after each step with house_preview and compare it with the photos. House frame: stand in front of the house facing its front facade; x runs to your right, z towards you, metres from the main block's centre. Facades: front, back, left, right as seen from the front. An opening's offset is measured on its own facade standing outside facing it: from that facade's LEFT end to the opening's centre.

front.description: Compass side the front facade faces: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW (or degrees)

open.description: A structure on posts of its own (a carport, a pergola, a gazebo): its main block has open sides, the roof hanging at wallHeight (default a thin flat roof); add the posts with house_set_block. Moved and turned apart from the house

plinthHeight.description: A raised base band under the walls, m (0 = none)

wallHeight.description: Ground to the eaves, m (about 2.8–3.2 for one storey, 5.5–6.5 for two)

zoneId.description: The building outline's zone id (default: the largest building)

name: house_build
